nodes.label: AiNode
nodes.rationale: AI is an optional block; typical scenarios are covered by buttons and conditions, so AI is used only where clients write free-form text.

nodes.label: makePlan
nodes.rationale: In the production version the plan is composed by Claude (Opus) from the task text, attachments and knowledge base; the prototype only keyword-matches to emulate this.

nodes.label: Composer
nodes.rationale: The brief tells the user the agent will draft a plan first and do nothing until that plan is approved.

nodes.label: AgentPage
nodes.rationale: Agent tasks follow plan → approval → execution → report; each step is simulated with two ticks (start → done) and would be a server-side queue in production; risky steps pause for explicit user confirmation.

hyperedges.label: Agent task lifecycle: plan → approval → execution → report
